originalEvidence.acceptedIdentityBasis: The outgoing butler Subaru disappears before Wilhelm fades in. White brushed-back hair, curled white moustache and chin beard, blue lapel panels with pale piping, black bow, frilled white shirt and pale buttoned waistcoat match wilhelm01's real texture; neither weapon harness nor shoulder armor is present. The choice display later blurs the same model. Only identity is accepted.
